item.title: Iran’s New Supreme Leader Was Wounded Early in the War, Iranian and Israeli Officials Say
item.summary: Officials say Mojtaba Khamenei’s legs were hurt, but the circumstances as well as the extent of his injuries were unclear. He has remained out of view since being announced as leader three days ago.

item.title: How Trump and His Advisers Miscalculated Iran’s Response to War
item.summary: In the lead-up to the U.S.-Israeli attack, President Trump downplayed the risks to the energy markets as a short-term concern that should not overshadow the mission to decapitate the Iranian regime.

item.title: Missiles, Drones and Airstrikes Pound Middle East Into 12th Day of War
item.summary: The effects of the war are being felt through the Persian Gulf.

item.title: Here’s What Happened in the War in the Middle East on Tuesday
item.summary: Trump administration officials cast the president as the sole arbiter on the U.S. war effort. International aid groups were warning of a growing humanitarian crisis in Lebanon, where nearly 700,000 people had been displaced, the U.N. said.

item.title: U.S. Forces Attack Iranian Mine-Laying Ships Near the Strait of Hormuz
item.summary: A video posted by the U.S. Central Command showed munitions striking nine vessels, most of which were moored at the time. Whether any mines have been laid in Gulf waters was unclear.

item.title: Democrats Demand Hegseth and Rubio Testify on Iran War
item.summary: Senate Democratic leaders called on President Trump to dispatch the senior cabinet officials to make the case to Congress and the American public for the war in Iran.

item.title: Iranian Military Shows It Knows How to Adapt, U.S. Officials Say
item.summary: Iran appears to be targeting what it views as American vulnerabilities, including air defenses meant to guard troops and assets in the region.

item.title: Trump Tries to Sidestep Blame for Any Civilian Deaths in Iran
item.summary: The president and the Pentagon have cast blame on Iran for the mounting toll. More than 1,800 people have died in the war, including many civilians.

item.title: War in Iran Could Lead to Food Shortages in Region, Experts Warn
item.summary: Some residents of Lebanon, Gaza and Iran are reporting shortages of food, rising food prices and other disruptions to food supplies as the conflict in the Middle East continues.

item.title: U.S. Showers Iran With Bombs in Most Intense Strikes of the War, Pentagon Says
item.summary: Iranians cowered under the barrage as Pete Hegseth, the U.S. defense secretary, said the U.S. aimed to wipe out Iran’s capacity to obtain nuclear weapons “forever.”
